source.author: lucan
source.text: Numquam saevae sperare novercae Plus licuit.
source.text_original: Numquam saevae sperare novercae / Plus licuit.
source.text_english: It was never more permissible to hope from a cruel stepmother.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_original: hic soror Aeoliden aevum mansura per omne / deserit, heu saevae nequiquam erepta novercae.
reuse.text_english: Here the sister leaves the Aeolid, to remain through all time, alas, snatched in vain from her cruel stepmother.
